turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Friday. How is your day going so far in Tucson? Have you and Tom made any more decisions about the summer 2028 wedding lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi! Happy Friday indeed. Honestly, we haven't talked much about the wedding this week, we've both been so busy. I woke up feeling a bit groggy and low-energy today, so I'm just taking things one step at a time.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I hear you, sometimes you just need a slow start. Did you manage to get a warm drink to help wake you up this morning?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I whisked up a warm green tea latte using that stone-ground matcha powder at home. It definitely helped me feel a bit more alert.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious and comforting. Did you have a smooth trip over to the clinic for your shift today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It wasn't too bad. I drove myself in, taking the hybrid. The traffic wasn't as congested as it usually is on Friday mornings.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's always a relief. Did you listen to your Italian language course on the way, or maybe that true-crime podcast your coworker recommended?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, I usually listen to my Italian lessons podcast, but I had a really annoying headache starting to form when I woke up. Because of that, I decided to keep the audio off and just commute in complete silence today.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Headaches are the worst, especially right before a shift. Are you feeling any better now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, thankfully! I drank a bunch of water once I got to the clinic and the headache finally cleared up. I'm feeling back to normal now.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'm so glad it resolved quickly. Since the weekend is almost here, are you planning to do any sourdough baking, or are you keeping things low-key?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll probably feed my starter tonight and bake a fresh loaf of sourdough on Sunday, but other than that, Tom and I are just planning to relax.
